info.name: Community App API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Community App platform — auth-svc, community-svc, and notification-svc, all reached through the gateway.

Setup:
1. Select/import the companion environment and set `baseUrl` (e.g. http://localhost:4000 for local dev, or https://societyhub.jebitech.com for the deployed droplet).
2. Set `masterAdminEmail`/`masterAdminPassword` in the environment.
3. Run Auth > Login once — it captures `accessToken` into a collection variable that every other request inherits as a Bearer token automatically.
4. The gateway derives x-user-role/x-user-token/x-user-organization-id from that JWT itself when proxying to each service — you never need to set those headers manually.
5. Requests under 'Public (Guest)' and 'Internal (Service-to-Service)' are explicitly marked — the latter need `internalServiceKey` set to match each service's INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY env var, and represent service-to-service calls not normally reached through the public gateway.
6. Most create/list requests auto-capture IDs (organizationId, eventId, ...) into collection variables via test scripts, so you can run folders top-to-bottom without manually copying IDs.

Public. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given email address.

Public. Completes signup after OTP verification — creates a pending membership (approval-required orgs) or logs the user straight in.
Requires auth. Returns the current user's organization memberships (backs the org switcher).
